exam_context: SSC CGL Tier 1 2026 — first stage of the two-tier selection process (Tier 1, Tier 2) for Combined Graduate Level Group B and C posts in various Indian central government ministries/departments.
data_provenance: Estimated from SSC's official CGL exam pattern/notification as reported by multiple 2025-2026 coaching/exam-tracker sources (PhysicsWallah, Careers360, Adda247, CareerPower, Testbook, LearnTheta), cross-checked Sep 2026. The sectional-timing detail (15 minutes/section from 2026) is reported by some but not all trackers as of this check — flagged below as a recent, not-yet-universally-confirmed procedural change.

marking_scheme.source_note: Confirmed via multiple Sep 2026 sources describing the SSC CGL Tier 1 marking pattern; unchanged across recent cycles.
marking_scheme.correct_answer: +2 marks (each of the 25 questions per section is worth 2 marks, for 50 marks/section)
marking_scheme.qualifying_nature: Tier 1 marks do NOT count toward the final merit list. Tier 1 is purely a qualifying/screening round — candidates must clear the Tier 1 cut-off to be shortlisted for Tier 2, where final ranking is decided.
marking_scheme.normalization_note: When Tier 1 is conducted across multiple shifts/days, scores are normalized across shifts to account for difficulty variation before cut-offs are applied.
marking_scheme.sectional_cutoffs: No official sectional cut-offs in Tier 1 — only an overall cut-off (category-wise) applies.
marking_scheme.question_types_used: Single-correct 5-option MCQ only. No descriptive, numerical-value, or multiple-correct questions in Tier 1.

exam_logistics.extended_duration_pwd: 80 minutes for candidates with benchmark disabilities (scribe-eligible categories), per standard SSC accommodation policy
exam_logistics.sectional_timing_2026_note: Multiple 2026 trackers report SSC has introduced independent 15-minute sectional timing (section auto-closes when its time elapses) as a change from the earlier free-movement 60-minute format. Confirm against the live-cycle official notification, as this is a recent and not universally corroborated change.
exam_logistics.medium_of_exam: English and Hindi, except the English Comprehension section, which is tested only in English
selection_stages: Tier 2 Paper II (Statistics — JSO/Statistical Investigator Grade-II posts only)
Tier 2 Paper III (General Studies Finance & Economics — AAO posts only)
exam_logistics.final_merit_weighting_note: Final selection merit is based on Tier 2 performance (and Tier 2's Computer Proficiency/DEST qualifying components where applicable); Tier 1 performance itself is not carried forward into the merit calculation.

downstream_stage_context.note: Included for reference only — these stages are NOT part of the Tier 1 exam being seeded here.

tier2_paper2_statistics.applicable_to: JSO / Statistical Investigator Grade-II posts only

downstream_stage_context.dest: Data Entry Speed Test — qualifying typing-speed test, no negative marking
